voiceover_script.text: Across the world, conversations about artificial intelligence are raising a central question: what does it mean for technology to serve people?
Across the AI4IA conversations, Access Age is presented not as an abstraction, but as a challenge with concrete human consequences — for people who depend on these systems to work, and work fairly.
But the promise of AI is not automatic. Every benefit comes with a risk, and every advance leaves questions about who is left behind.
The measure of AI will not be the speed of its systems, but whether the people it touches are better served, better heard, and more free.
